register.labelZh: STRIKE 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: strike at 和 strike out at 可以描述不同形式的攻擊;strike back 則表示某人在受到攻擊或批評後作出反擊。；strike down 可以表示某人突然病重,也可以表示法院裁定法律或規則無效。；strike off 可以表示取消專業資格或用力擊掉物件的一部分;strike out 和 strike through則常用於修改文字。；strike up 可表示樂手開始演奏;strike out 則是棒球中的重要表達。
register.summaryEn: Strike at and strike out at describe different kinds of attempted blows. Strike back shows how someone responds after being attacked or criticised. Strike down can describe a sudden serious illness. It can also describe a court making a law or rule invalid. Strike off can describe professional disqualification or the physical removal of part of an object. Strike out and strike through are useful when correcting written work. Strike up is used when musicians begin playing. Strike out is an important expression in baseball.
contextsZh: 理解疾病和重要法院裁決
contextsEn: Talk about attacks and responses clearly
Understand illness and important court decisions
Talk about different kinds of removal

fixedVariable.variableZh: 保留原句中的人物、事物、時間和意思。；strike at somebody 通常表示用武器或物件試圖擊打某人;strike out at somebody 通常表示因憤怒或害怕而突然揮拳、揮爪或攻擊。；strike off 有兩個截然不同的意思:它可以表示把某人從正式名單中除名,也可以表示用力擊掉某物的一部分。
fixedVariable.variableEn: Keep the same people, things, time and meaning. Strike at somebody usually describes an attempt to hit, often with a weapon or object. Strike out at somebody usually describes a sudden blow made in anger or fear. Strike off has two very different meanings. It can mean removing someone from an official list, or removing part of something with a hard blow.
